items.title: ExxonMobil Holdings (XOM) Fined Over Scottish Gas Leaks And Revamps Inspection Standards
items.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings (NYSE:XOM) has been fined by UK authorities after multiple flammable gas leaks at its former Scottish ethylene plant. Investigators found the company’s inspection system for corrosion and leak risks at the site was inadequate. ExxonMobil has acknowledged the breaches and overhauled its inspection and corrosion risk management standards across its wider operations. The case raises questions around regulatory, safety and operational risks, along with possible reputational...
